about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer & Creative Problem Solver
about.description: Computer Science student specializing in full-stack web development with strong frontend expertise in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern UI engineering. Experienced in building scalable and responsive web applications, optimizing frontend performance, integrating APIs and CMS systems, and developing full-stack solutions.
about.passionText: I'm passionate about frontend architecture, user experience, and high-performance web applications. Whether it's crafting pixel-perfect UIs, building custom product configurators, or architecting robust backend systems, I bring creativity and technical excellence to every project.

aqwas.title: Software Development Intern
aqwas.description: Led the frontend redesign and development of a government tourism platform for the Asser region using Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Designed and implemented 20+ responsive pages and reusable UI components based on Figma designs. Increased website performance by 80% through Lighthouse optimization. Built Arabic/English localization with dark/light mode support. Integrated frontend with Directus CMS and contributed to an AI SaaS Proposal Generator with OpenAI GPT features.

harmonically.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
harmonically.description: Worked as a junior full-stack developer for ~7 months on a startup team, contributing to two production platforms that are now live and have been sold. Built EcoSouk, a multi-tenant marketplace with merchant admin, and Asalyha, an e-commerce platform for a Saudi Arabia-based retailer. Used TypeScript and Medusa JS as the commerce backend.

united.title: Network Operations Center (NOC) Specialist
united.description: Troubleshoot network issues, detect and respond to alerts, configure and deploy network equipment, and support remote access services.

oscar.title: Business Operations Manager
oscar.description: Managed and participated with a team in a printing house and cybercafé. Fixed streamlining issues, learned various printing tools, and participated in pricing and customer negotiations.
